validation_verdict: Nuisance Validation Finding: Appending tokens produces massive JS divergence (0.5449) solely due to RoPE positional shifting. When interventions are strictly length-matched in context, JS divergence is only 0.060671 for neutral text and 0.020862 for entity replacement. This decisively proves that the previously reported 0.5792 JS divergence was a positional artifact, not a contextual sensitivity.
